simple.summary: עָרַר (ʻârar) means to bare ; figuratively, to demolish First listed occurrence: Isa 23 13.

definitions.usage: make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), × utterly.
definitions.full: H6209. arar II.
